name: SOC 2 (Type II)
description: AICPA System and Organization Controls 2 — trust services criteria across 5 categories; Type II requires evidence of operating effectiveness over a period.

controls.name: Control environment
controls.req: Commitment to integrity, ethical values, and board/senior management oversight of internal control.

controls.name: Communication and information
controls.req: Relevant information communicated internally/externally; incident and control-deviation communication paths.

controls.name: Risk assessment
controls.req: Identify, analyze and manage risks of meeting objectives (FR/CSR): fraud, change, system operations.

controls.name: Monitoring activities
controls.req: Monitor control operation (ongoing evaluations, separate evaluations) and remediate deficiencies.

controls.name: Control activities
controls.req: Policies and procedures establishing control activities across the org (segregation, approvals).

controls.name: Logical and physical access
controls.req: Restrict logical and physical access to systems/data: least privilege, authentication, MFA, termination revocation.

controls.name: System operations
controls.req: Manage system operations: vulnerability mgmt, monitoring, incident detection/response, change management (data retention incl.).

controls.name: Change management
controls.req: Authorized, designed, developed, tested, approved, implemented and documented changes; detection of unauthorized changes.

controls.name: Risk mitigation
controls.req: Business disruption risks addressed (BC/DR); vendor and business-partner risks mitigated.

controls.name: Availability commitments
controls.req: Availability commitments (SLA uptime) met, monitored, and reported; capacity planning for expected loads.

controls.name: Recovery planning
controls.req: Recovery plan and procedures for disruptions: RTO/RPO definitions, backup, DR exercises, communication.

controls.name: Environmental protections
controls.req: Physical and environmental controls (power, cooling, fire) aligned with commitments.

controls.name: Processing integrity commitments
controls.req: System processing is complete, valid, timely, accurate and authorized per commitments (input validation, reconciliations).

controls.name: Error handling
controls.req: Processing errors detected, logged and remediated; exception reporting meets commitments.

controls.name: Data correction
controls.req: Incorrect data corrected and communicated to affected parties per commitments.

controls.name: Confidential information identification
controls.req: Identify and classify confidential information per commitments (labels, inventories).

controls.name: Confidentiality safeguards
controls.req: Safeguards (encryption, access control, DLP, disposal) for confidential information through lifecycle.

controls.name: Confidentiality incident handling
controls.req: Confidentiality breach detection, response and notification aligned with commitments.

controls.name: Notice
controls.req: Provide notice of privacy practices (collection, use, retention, disclosure) to data subjects (DPDP-aligned where applicable).

controls.name: Choice and consent
controls.req: Offer choice and obtain consent for PII collection, use and disclosure; honor preferences.

controls.name: Collection
controls.req: Collect PII only per commitments — minimal, lawful collection.

controls.name: Use, retention and disposal
controls.req: Use PII per commitments; retain per schedule; dispose securely on expiry of purpose.

controls.name: Access
controls.req: Provide data subjects access to their PII and permit correction/amendment as committed.

controls.name: Disclosure and notification
controls.req: Disclose PII to third parties per commitments; notify subjects on breach (DPDP breach notification alignment).

controls.name: Quality
controls.req: Maintain accurate, complete PII; correct/update as needed.

controls.name: Monitoring and enforcement
controls.req: Monitor compliance with privacy commitments and enforce controls (reviews, remediation of lapses).
